instruction: Select any cell with data in it, then select the Insert tab and Table. In the box that opens, make sure My table has headers is ticked, and select OK.
title: Animation: select a cell, select the Insert tab, then Table, and the rows become a table
intro: Press Play to watch step 5: a cell, then Insert, then Table.

steps.caption: Select any cell with data in it. Here, A1.
Select the Insert tab, the third tab after File and Home.
Select Table, near the left end of the Insert tab.
In the Create Table box, make sure My table has headers is ticked, then select OK.
steps.note: The Create Table box opens here (not shown). Make sure My table has headers is ticked, then select OK.

steps.caption: The rows are now a striped table, and a Table Design tab has appeared at the end of the ribbon.
